import numpy as np


def q209(scores, targets):
    scores, targets = (
        np.asarray(scores, float),
        np.asarray(targets, float),
    )
    unique, inverse = np.unique(scores, return_inverse=True)
    weight = np.bincount(inverse)
    total = np.bincount(inverse, weights=targets)
    blocks = []
    for i, (w, s) in enumerate(zip(weight, total)):
        blocks.append([i, i, float(w), float(s)])
        while (
            len(blocks) > 1
            and blocks[-2][3] / blocks[-2][2]
            > blocks[-1][3] / blocks[-1][2]
        ):
            b = blocks.pop()
            a = blocks.pop()
            blocks.append([a[0], b[1], a[2] + b[2], a[3] + b[3]])
    result = np.empty(len(unique))
    for start, end, w, s in blocks:
        result[start : end + 1] = s / w
    return (unique, result)
